notes.title: Patch Notes for June 24
notes.notes:
The big one: More normal camera controls

The camera now handles mouse input differently and is a lot less reliant on your dpi.



Small changes:

Cyberspace loads your camera speed instead of using the default one

Fixed a bug in cyberspace that lead to a logic loop of the final boss

Minor improvements to the gate and the elevator in the station entrance

Fixed a bug that caused the baby pickup to spawn twice in the sewers

Made the robot at the top of the generator a bit more responsive (just a bit)

Made the office elevator more legible

Tweaked some sounds

Added a little friend somewhere that I've been thinking about



Please note: For now, this update unfortunately only affects the PC version as I can not produce a Mac build from my computer.

notes.title: Camera Update
notes.notes:
I made some adjustments based on your feedback:


 You can now select between two camera modes in the options: "Follow loosely" and "Locked to player", which is a more traditional camera and enabled by default.
 The camera sensitivity option has been adjusted to take high screen resolutions into account.
 The speed of the item wheel is now directly tied to the camera speed.
 Jumping has been slightly tweaked and debugged. 
 I found some boring bugs along the way that are now fixed as well.

It's been great to see people play the demo, thank y'all so much! Let me know how these changes work out for you.
